twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication

tags.title: Tags
tags.intro: Tags group your monitors: you can filter the monitor list by tag and add or remove a tag on many selected monitors at once. You assign tags to a monitor while editing it.
tags.readOnly: Only members who can manage monitors can create, edit or delete tags.

delete.title: Delete the tag?
delete.confirm: The tag “{name}” is removed from every monitor, together with the value each monitor gave it. The monitors keep running and alerting as before; they only lose this tag. This cannot be undone.
delete.confirmUsed: {n} monitor uses the tag “{name}”; it is removed from it, together with the value the monitor gave it. The monitor keeps running and alerting as before; it only loses this tag. This cannot be undone. | {n} monitors use the tag “{name}”; it is removed from each of them, together with the value each monitor gave it. The monitors keep running and alerting as before; they only lose this tag. This cannot be undone.

common.name: Name
common.activeHint: A paused monitor is not checked and does not alert.
common.invertedHint: Treat a failing check as up and a passing check as down.
common.intervalMin: The interval must be at least {min} seconds for this type.
common.heartbeatIntervalHint: How often the job must check in. The grace period is added on top.
common.timeoutHint: At most 80% of the check interval.
common.retriesHint: Failed checks repeated before the monitor is marked down.
common.heartbeatRetryHint: After a missed check-in, the next miss counts after this long.

alerting.resendHint: Repeat the alert while the monitor stays down. 0 sends no reminders.
alerting.notifyChanges: Notify about certificate, DNS and expiry changes

cron.maxRuntimeHint: Optional. Mark the job failed when it runs longer than this.

import.title: Import from Uptime Kuma
import.intro: Upload a copy of your Uptime Kuma database to bring its monitors, notification channels, tags, status pages, incidents and maintenance windows into this workspace. The upload is analyzed first; nothing is created until you run the import.

upload.help: Take a consistent copy first: stop Uptime Kuma, or run sqlite3 kuma.db ".backup kuma-export.db" while it runs. See the "Migrating from Uptime Kuma" section of the README for the supported sources.
upload.tooLarge: The file is larger than the {max} MB upload limit.

import.blocked: An import is already open in this workspace. Finish it or delete it before uploading another file.
